title: D-BTP: Dynamic Bucket Tree of Permutation — Directional Structural Generation and Hypothesis Evolution
description:
D-BTP (Dynamic Bucket Tree of Permutation) is a research framework for dynamic structural hypothesis search. It develops state-dependent candidate generation, constraint-guided structural composition, coupled directional generation and selection, weak-evidence exploration, and feedback-driven search control. Extensions examine multi-agent hypothesis competition, structural relay, collective learning, and potential recursive evolution of directional fields and structural operators.

This v1.0.0 research release presents eight foundations papers, four specifications, three application cases, three extensions, and proposed validation protocols. Performance gains, cross-domain transfer, open-ended growth, and recursive self-improvement remain testable research hypotheses rather than established empirical results.
